b001.text: Night one of a hundred. What if you went to sleep tonight… and woke to find it hanging above your bed? Upside down. Watching you breathe.

b002.text: The Vetala. India's oldest nightmare. A spirit that climbs inside a corpse, wears it like a coat… and sleeps hanging from the trees of the burning ground.

b003.text: A thousand years ago, King Vikram was sent to fetch one from its tree. But its stories ended in riddles — and the moment the king answered, the Vetala flew back. Twenty-five times.

b004.text: And here is why the stories fear it. A Vetala knows the past. The present. And the future. It knows everything you're hiding.

b005.text: So tell me. Is it real? If it is… where is it hanging tonight? And if you woke beneath one — what's the first thing you would ask it?
